label: Bible Study
prompt: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was _____ and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
verse: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
note: The opening of Job — the land of Uz, a good man, and no hint yet of the storm coming.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found _____ with God.
verse: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
note: Gabriel greets a startled young woman in Nazareth: fear not, Mary — you've found favour with God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the city lieth _____, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
verse: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
note: The new Jerusalem lies foursquare — its length, breadth, and height all equal.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou art _____, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
verse: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
note: The elders cast their crowns before the throne and sing — worthy, because he created all things.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to _____ all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verse: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
note: The shield of faith can 'quench all the fiery darts of the wicked' — flaming arrows put out on impact.
